2607.25895.title: HiFi-UMI: Learning Deployable Manipulation Policies from High-Fidelity UMI Data Alone
2607.25895.abstract: Learning deployable manipulation policies is bottlenecked by the scarcity of data that is both high-fidelity and scalable. Real-robot teleoperation is accurate but costly to scale; robot-free UMI capture scales readily, and current practice uses the resulting data mainly for pre-training, adding a small real-robot "anchor" at post-training. We ask whether raising the fidelity of robot-free UMI data, rather than shrinking the real-robot fraction, can remove that anchor. We present HiFi-UMI, a portable UMI data-production system co-designed for trajectory accuracy, inter-gripper relative pose, synchronization, and field of view: head-mounted offline stereo-inertial SLAM, native rather than reconstructed relative pose, a shared microsecond GPIO trigger, and two wide-angle cameras per hand covering ~200 degrees. It reaches 3 mm workspace-local end-effector accuracy without external tracking infrastructure. Using this corpus, we demonstrate zero-robot post-training: a policy post-trained solely on HiFi-UMI demonstrations deploys directly on a real robot and matches in-domain teleoperation across three backbones spanning the vision-language-action and world-action-model families, with success-rate differences of -2.5, +3.1, and -0.6 percentage points on StarVLA-QwenPI, OpenPI-pi_0.5, and LingBot-VA; the strongest policy reaches 85% on a precision insertion task, even though the teleoperation baseline is collected in the evaluation scene and no HiFi-UMI trajectory is. Pre-training on 4,000 hours from the same corpus lowers action error on ten unseen tasks by 41% and, on StarVLA-QwenPI, raises real-robot success by a further 18.1 percentage points. We open-source HiFi-UMI-2K, 2,000 hours of microsecond-synchronized, ultra-wide-FoV demonstrations, each automatically reconstructed and validated through simulation replay, as a large-scale, high-fidelity resource for the robot-learning community.
2607.25895.abstract_zh: 学习可部署操作策略的瓶颈在于同时具备高保真度和可扩展性的数据稀缺。真实机器人遥操作虽精确但规模化成本高昂；无机器人UMI（通用操作接口）采集易于扩展，目前业界主要将其用于预训练，并在训练后补充少量真实机器人"锚定"数据。我们探讨是否可以通过提升无机器人UMI数据的保真度——而非缩减真实机器人数据比例——来消除这种锚定依赖。本文提出HiFi-UMI系统，这套便携式UMI数据生产系统协同优化了轨迹精度、抓手间相对位姿、同步性与视野范围：采用头戴式离线双目惯性SLAM（即时定位与地图构建）技术、原生（非重建）相对位姿计算、微秒级GPIO共享触发器，以及每只手上两个覆盖约200度视野的广角摄像头。该系统在无需外部跟踪基础设施的情况下，实现了工作空间内末端执行器3毫米的定位精度。基于此数据资源，我们展示了零机器人后训练方案：完全使用HiFi-UMI示范数据进行后训练的策略，可直接在真实机器人上部署，并在跨越视觉-语言-动作与世界观-动作模型两大框架的三种骨干模型中，达到与领域内遥操作相当的性能——StarVLA-QwenPI、OpenPI-pi_0.5和LingBot-VA的成功率差异分别为-2.5、+3.1和-0.6个百分点；最优策略在精密插入任务中达到85%成功率，尽管遥操作基线数据采集自评估场景，而所有HiFi-UMI轨迹均未接触该场景。使用同源4000小时数据进行预训练，可使十个未见任务的动作误差降低41%，并在StarVLA-QwenPI模型上进一步提升真实机器人任务成功率18.1个百分点。我们开源HiFi-UMI-2K数据集，包含2000小时微秒级同步、超宽视野示范数据，每条轨迹均通过仿真回放自动重建与验证，为机器人学习社区提供了大规模、高保真的研究资源。

2607.24223.title: A New Role for Relevance: Guiding Corpus Interaction in Agentic Search
2607.24223.abstract: Relevance is a query-dependent estimate of whether a document or excerpt contains useful evidence. Existing retrieval agents use relevance to select top-$k$ content, but document relevance alone cannot localize, compose, or verify the evidence required by complex questions. Direct Corpus Interaction (DCI) enables such fine-grained operations through grep-style exploration, but its relevance-agnostic search can expose useful clues late and delay convergence. Recent advances use relevance to narrow the corpus into a working space for interaction. Once interaction begins, however, relevance still does not directly guide which documents grep searches first or distinguish informative excerpts from a broad set of matches to let LLMs see them first. We introduce the Relevance-Aware RipGrep Search Agent (RARG), which turns relevance into an execution prior for corpus interaction. RARG provides coarse-to-fine relevance guidance: it orders documents for sequential 'ripgrep' traversal to expose globally relevant clues earlier, initializes promising entry points with query-relevant paragraphs, and reranks grep matches to surface informative excerpts that document-level ranking may otherwise obscure. Across challenging browse question answering and reasoning-intensive retrieval, RARG improves the accuracy--efficiency frontier over retrieval-based and direct-interaction agents. These results demonstrate that relevance-aware interaction enables faster and more reliable search convergence.
2607.24223.abstract_zh: 相关性是对文档或摘录是否包含有用证据的一种依赖于查询的估计。现有的检索智能体利用相关性来选取前$k$位内容，但仅凭文档相关性无法定位、组合或验证复杂问题所需的证据。直接语料库交互通过类grep式探索实现了此类细粒度操作，但其忽略相关性的搜索可能延迟暴露有用线索并延缓收敛过程。近期研究通过相关性将语料库缩小为交互工作空间，然而一旦交互开始，相关性仍不能直接指导grep搜索优先遍历哪些文档，也无法从广泛匹配项中区分信息丰富的摘录以供大型语言模型优先处理。我们提出了相关性感知的RipGrep搜索智能体，它将相关性转化为语料库交互的执行先验。RARG提供从粗到细的相关性指导：通过排序文档以实现顺序化的'ripgrep'遍历，从而更早暴露全局相关线索；利用查询相关段落初始化有潜力的切入点；并对grep匹配结果进行重排序，以突显文档级排序可能忽略的信息性摘录。在具有挑战性的浏览问答和推理密集型检索任务中，RARG在准确率-效率边界上超越了基于检索的智能体与直接交互智能体。这些结果表明，相关性感知的交互能够实现更快、更可靠的搜索收敛。

2607.25565.title: ReDesign: Recovering Editable Design Structures from Images via Agentic Decomposition
2607.25565.abstract: Recovering an editable design file from a raster image is a common and costly bottleneck in modern design workflows, yet remains challenging since editability depends on recovering multi-modal attributes, such as typography, vector geometry, colors, grouping, and layer ordering. We present ReDesign, an agentic framework that grows an editable layer hierarchy by selecting and composing specialized tools across modalities. To keep this long decision process reliable despite imperfect tool outputs, we introduce graceful verification at each expansion, which provides local accept, prune, or retry feedback that prevents error accumulation and avoids large scale reruns. To evaluate editability at scale, we introduce the Figma Edit Replay Benchmark, consisting of 909 raw Figma files and 14,796 controlled edit instructions that replay edits on reconstructed outputs. Across this benchmark and standard reconstruction metrics, ReDesign achieves strong visual fidelity while delivering the highest editability across layout, color, and text edits, outperforming layered decomposition baselines and serial tool use pipelines.
2607.25565.abstract_zh: 从栅格图像中恢复可编辑的设计文件是现代设计流程中一个普遍且代价高昂的瓶颈，这仍然具有挑战性，因为可编辑性依赖于恢复多模态属性，如字体排版、矢量几何、颜色、分组和图层顺序。我们提出了ReDesign，这是一个智能体框架，通过跨模态选择并组合专用工具来逐步构建可编辑的图层层级结构。为了确保这一长决策过程的可靠性，尽管工具输出可能不完美，我们在每次层级扩展时引入了优雅验证机制，该机制提供局部接受、修剪或重试的反馈，从而防止错误累积并避免大规模重新运行。为了大规模评估可编辑性，我们引入了Figma编辑回放基准测试，该基准包含909个原始Figma文件和14,796条受控的编辑指令，用于在重建的输出上回放编辑操作。在此基准测试及标准重建指标上，ReDesign在实现强视觉保真度的同时，在布局、颜色和文本编辑方面提供了最高的可编辑性，优于分层分解基线方法和串行工具使用流程。

2607.24368.title: Keep It InMind: Benchmarking the Implicit-Association Blind Spot in Agent Memory
2607.24368.abstract: Long-term memory systems store what a user says in an external store and retrieve it when a related query arrives. This interface rests on an assumption so natural that it is rarely stated: a memory that is needed will resemble the query that needs it. World knowledge breaks the assumption. A tree-nut allergy should change the answer to a macaron request through their almond-flour ingredient, yet the two texts share no cue a retriever can see. We call this failure mode the implicit-association blind spot and introduce InMind, a 125-task, expert-verified benchmark spanning ten life domains, with 113 tasks grounded in citable public sources. Its paired controls separate three explanations that existing evaluations conflate: the fact was never stored, the model lacks the bridging knowledge, or the fact was stored and never surfaced. The verdict is clean. With the decisive memory placed in context, the backbone answers 84.0 percent of indirect queries; when the same memory must be retrieved, six vector, graph, and agentic memory systems reach at most 14.4 percent, even though they recall the same facts on demand at up to 100 percent. An embedding with eight times the dimensionality raises answer-blind target recall for every system yet leaves the gap essentially intact. A minimal diagnostic probe that keeps memory visible before the query arrives recovers most of the gap, locating the failure in the query-conditioned interface itself and pointing to routing, deciding which facts must stay visible, as the open problem InMind is built to score.
2607.24368.abstract_zh: 长期记忆系统将用户所言存储于外部存储器，并在相关查询到达时进行检索。这一接口基于一个自然而鲜少被明言的假设：所需记忆应与触发它的查询具有相似性。然而世界知识打破了这一假设。例如对坚果过敏的患者可能会因马卡龙含有杏仁粉成分而需要调整食用建议，但这两段文本之间并不存在检索器可识别的显性关联线索。我们将这种失效模式称为隐式关联盲区，并为此构建了InMind——一个包含125项任务、经专家验证的基准测试集，涵盖十大生活领域，其中113项任务基于可溯源的公开资料。其配对控制组分离了现有评估中混淆的三种解释：信息从未存储、模型缺乏桥梁性知识、或信息已存储却未能被激活。测试结果清晰表明：当决定性记忆被置于上下文中时，基础模型能回答84.0%的间接查询；而当需要通过检索获取同一记忆时，六种基于向量、图结构与智能体（agentic）的记忆系统最高仅能达到14.4%的准确率——尽管这些系统在直接查询时对相同事实的召回率可达100%。将嵌入维度提升八倍虽能提高各系统对目标信息的召回率，但性能鸿沟依然存在。一个在查询到达前保持记忆可见的最小诊断探针恢复了大部分性能差距，这证明失效根源在于查询条件接口本身，并指向记忆路由（即决定哪些事实需保持可见性）这一开放性问题——这也正是InMind基准旨在评估的核心维度。

2607.24904.title: Mage-VL: An Efficient Codec-Native Streaming Multimodal Foundation Model
2607.24904.abstract: Standard vision-language models (VLMs) suffer from Moravec's paradox: they excel at complex offline visual reasoning but struggle with simple streaming perception tasks and process them inefficiently. We present Mage-VL, an efficient codec-native streaming foundation model for real-time multimodal understanding and interaction. At its core, our custom tokenizer, Mage-ViT, replaces uniform frame sampling by selectively encoding dynamic, entropy-rich regions using motion vectors and residual energy across sparse anchor (I) and predicted (P) frames. Operating at a 16 x 16 patch level, this reduces visual token consumption by over 75% while preserving spatiotemporal context. Trained from scratch on approximately 560M unlabeled images and 100M unlabeled video frames, Mage-ViT matches or outperforms flagship encoders trained on billions of image-text pairs. We establish AI4AI data pipelines encompassing prompt-code joint optimization for multimodal captioning and AI-driven performance diagnosis to guide training recipes. Furthermore, through a bio-inspired dual-system architecture - a lightweight System 1 event gate and a causal System 2 decoder - Mage-VL enables proactive streaming perception. Extensive evaluations show that Mage-VL-4B matches Qwen3-VL-4B on static tasks while achieving strong gains in video understanding and 2D/3D spatial reasoning, with up to a 3.5x wall-clock inference speedup, and comprehensively surpasses the 15B Phi-4-reasoning-vision baseline. Beyond model artifacts, we deliver seven key empirical findings covering pre-training data efficiency, variable-resolution scaling, codec system acceleration, VideoQA SFT redundancy, motion-spatial synergy, AI4AI data pipelines, and Zero-Vision SFT for multimodal RL.
2607.24904.abstract_zh: 标准视觉语言模型（VLMs）普遍面临莫拉维克悖论：它们擅长复杂的离线视觉推理，却在简单的流式感知任务上表现不佳且处理效率低下。我们提出了Mage-VL——一种高效的编解码器原生流式基础模型，专为实时多模态理解与交互而设计。其核心是我们定制的分词器Mage-ViT，它摒弃了均匀帧采样方法，通过利用运动矢量和残差能量，在稀疏的关键帧（I帧）与预测帧（P帧）中有选择地编码动态、高熵区域。该模型在16×16的图像块级别运行，在保持时空上下文的同时，将视觉令牌消耗降低了超过75%。基于约5.6亿未标注图像和1亿未标注视频帧从头训练，Mage-ViT的性能达到甚至超越了基于数十亿图文对训练的旗舰编码器。我们建立了AI4AI数据流水线，涵盖针对多模态描述任务的提示-代码联合优化，以及用于指导训练方案的AI驱动性能诊断。此外，通过仿生双系统架构——轻量级系统1事件门控与因果系统2解码器——Mage-VL实现了主动流式感知。大量评估表明，Mage-VL-4B在静态任务上与Qwen3-VL-4B性能相当，同时在视频理解与2D/3D空间推理方面取得显著优势，推理速度最高提升3.5倍，并全面超越了15B参数的Phi-4-reasoning-vision基线模型。除模型本身外，我们贡献了七项关键实证发现，涵盖预训练数据效率、可变分辨率缩放、编解码系统加速、视频问答监督微调冗余性、运动-空间协同效应、AI4AI数据流水线，以及面向多模态强化学习的Zero-Vision监督微调。

2607.26057.title: Pass the Baton: Trajectory-Relayed On-Policy Distillation
2607.26057.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) grounds token-level supervision in the student's own trajectory, yet suffers from prefix failure: once the student commits to a wrong reasoning direction, all subsequent generation builds on this deviation, producing misdirected continuations that elicit unreliable supervision and waste compute. We identify a teacher-student continuation asymmetry on failed prefixes, where the teacher tends to redirect while the student continues along the original direction, and convert it into a label-free handoff trigger in Relay On-Policy Distillation (Relay-OPD). During training, Relay-OPD constructs relay trajectories by letting the teacher briefly take over at detected trigger points to produce a teacher leg, after which the student resumes and is optimized on the resulting trajectory. A limited relay budget concentrates intervention on critical early positions while limiting departure from the student policy. With a Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 teacher and Qwen3-0.6B/1.7B-Non-Thinking students on eight mathematical reasoning benchmarks, Relay-OPD achieves the best or second-best results on every benchmark, outperforming standard OPD by +5.73% and the strongest baseline FastOPD by +1.49% on average for 1.7B, with consistent gains at 0.6B. Training trajectory length is reduced by over 50%.
2607.26057.abstract_zh: 在线蒸馏（On-policy distillation, OPD）将词元级监督建立在学生自身轨迹的基础上，但存在前缀失败问题：一旦学生的推理方向出现错误，后续所有生成都会基于此偏差展开，从而产生方向错误的延续内容。这些错误延续不仅会引发不可靠的监督，还会浪费计算资源。我们发现在失败的前缀上存在师生延续的不对称性：教师倾向于调整方向，而学生则继续沿原方向生成。基于此观察，我们在接力在线蒸馏（Relay-OPD）中将这种不对称性转化为一种无需标签的切换触发机制。在训练过程中，当检测到触发点时，Relay-OPD会让教师短暂接管生成过程，形成一段教师轨迹段；随后学生恢复生成，并基于该拼接轨迹进行优化。有限的接力预算将干预集中在关键的前期位置，同时限制对学生策略的偏离。通过使用Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507作为教师模型，Qwen3-0.6B/1.7B-Non-Thinking作为学生模型，在八个数学推理基准测试中，Relay-OPD在所有基准上均取得最优或次优成绩。对于1.7B参数模型，其平均表现较标准OPD提升+5.73%，较最强基线FastOPD提升+1.49%；在0.6B参数模型上也呈现一致的性能增益。此外，训练轨迹长度减少了50%以上。

2607.25431.title: CodeNib: A Multi-View Data System for Serving Repository Context to Coding Agents
2607.25431.abstract: Coding agents repeatedly search, navigate, and retain context from evolving repositories, but disconnected indexes, language servers, and task-local histories force repeated discovery and obscure lifecycle costs. CodeNib builds reusable lexical, dense, and structural views per repository commit, maps outputs to repository-relative source ranges, maintains selected views across edits, and serves ranked search, symbol navigation, and bounded context through one runtime.Across 100 snapshots, we map quality-cost frontiers across the repository-context lifecycle. When outputs match an independent rebuild, graph and vector updates are $8.7\times$ and $25.4\times$ faster at the median. On the static-navigation subset matching normalized live-server locations (63% of 1,000 requests), the median per-request live/static latency ratio is $4.7\times$. Across five models, selected context policies preserve localization with 50--87% fewer trajectory tokens than paired grep/read. Together, these results support multi-view repository-context serving with explicit, operation-specific validity boundaries.
2607.25431.abstract_zh: 编码代理(Coding agents)持续搜索、导航并保留不断演化的代码库上下文，但割裂的索引工具、语言服务器以及任务本地历史记录迫使开发者重复探索过程，同时模糊了全生命周期的成本。CodeNib系统为每个仓库提交构建可复用的词法视图、稠密向量视图和结构视图，将输出结果映射至仓库相对源范围，在代码编辑过程中维持选定视图的持续性，并通过单一运行时提供排序搜索、符号导航和边界上下文服务。基于100个代码快照的实验，我们绘制出仓库上下文生命周期中质量与成本的前沿边界。当输出与独立重建结果一致时，图结构和向量更新的中位速度分别提升8.7倍和25.4倍。在与标准化实时服务器位置匹配的静态导航子集中（占1000次请求的63%），每次请求的实时/静态延迟比中位值为4.7倍。在五种模型测试中，精选的上下文策略在保持定位准确性的同时，比配对的grep/读取操作减少50-87%的轨迹令牌。综合来看，这些研究结果验证了具有明确操作有效性边界的多视图仓库上下文服务机制。

2607.26037.title: Wonder: Video World Model Done Better
2607.26037.abstract: We present Wonder, a general-purpose video world model for real-time, camera-controllable world exploration. Given an image or a conditional video, Wonder constructs a playable world where users can navigate interactively by moving the camera, discovering unseen regions, and revisiting previously observed areas in real time and over a long-term horizon. Achieving this capability requires a system-level co-design of control method, memory mechanism, and training strategy. We introduce a novel camera conditioning with a dense coordinate field whose renderings provide spatially aligned motion and orientation cues, allowing the model to interpret camera motion directly as visual evidence. To support fast and precise memory retrieval over a growing generation context, we propose an efficient sparse attention-based memory mechanism, enabling the model to selectively attend to a small set of relevant context tokens at inference time, regardless of actual context length. We further develop several techniques to rectify the self-forcing-style distillation pipeline, improving the student model's ability to respect control signals, as well as maintaining diverse generation modes and long-term memory from the teacher. Together, these components enable Wonder to synthesize diverse, minute-scale videos at 16 FPS while preserving coherent geometry, appearance, and dynamics across long rollouts. Beyond image-to-video generation, Wonder naturally supports video-conditioned generation, allowing existing dynamic scenes to be re-shot in real time.
2607.26037.abstract_zh:
我们推出Wonder，一款支持实时、相机可控世界探索的通用视频世界模型。该系统能够基于单张图像或条件视频构建可交互探索的动态世界，用户可通过移动相机实时发现未观测区域并重返已探索场景，且支持长时程交互。实现此功能需要从系统层面协同设计控制方法、记忆机制与训练策略。

我们提出一种创新的相机条件控制方法，采用密集坐标场进行渲染，生成具有空间对齐特征的运动与朝向线索，使模型能够直接将相机运动解读为视觉证据。为支持在持续扩展的生成上下文环境中实现快速精准的记忆检索，我们提出基于稀疏注意力机制的高效记忆模块，使模型在推理时能够选择性关注少量相关上下文标记，不受实际上下文长度限制。我们进一步开发多种技术以改进自强制式蒸馏训练流程，提升学生模型对控制信号的响应能力，同时保持教师模型的多样化生成模式与长时记忆能力。

这些组件的协同作用使Wonder能够以16帧/秒的速率合成多样化、分钟级时长的视频，并在长序列生成中保持连贯的几何结构、外观特征与动态特性。除图像到视频生成外，Wonder天然支持视频条件生成，可实现对现有动态场景的实时重摄。

2607.25857.title: Shieldstral
2607.25857.abstract: We introduce Shieldstral, a 3B-parameter policy-adaptive multimodal safety classifier that matches or outperforms models nearly 7$\times$ its size on text safety benchmarks and sets a new state of the art on multimodal safety classification. Shieldstral formulates content moderation as a binary question-answering task. This simple formulation unifies diverse moderation tasks into a single yes/no problem, enabling heterogeneous safety datasets with divergent taxonomies to be consolidated under one training framework. We present the data construction recipe, covering curation and generation of approximately 54.1M samples and a fine-grained evaluation set to evaluate policy adaptability. Together, these enable a small adaptive model to match or outperform much larger models.
2607.25857.abstract_zh: 我们推出Shieldstral，这是一个拥有30亿参数的政策自适应多模态安全分类器。它在文本安全基准测试中与规模近乎其7倍的模型表现相当甚至更优，并在多模态安全分类领域树立了新的技术标杆。Shieldstral将内容审核（content moderation）构建为一个二元问答任务。这种简洁的构建方式将多样化的审核任务统一为单一的“是/否”问题，使得具有不同分类体系的异构安全数据集能够整合到同一训练框架下。我们详细介绍了数据构建方案，涵盖约5410万个样本的筛选与生成过程，并创建了一个用于评估政策适应性的细粒度评估集。这些工作共同使得一个轻量级的自适应模型能够媲美甚至超越规模大得多的模型。

2607.24957.title: PerceptionBench: Evaluating Atomic Visual Perception in Multimodal Large Language Models
2607.24957.abstract: We introduce PerceptionBench, a benchmark specifically designed to evaluate the atomic visual perception capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Existing benchmarks often fail to isolate perception: holistic evaluations conflate perceptual errors with failures in reasoning or domain knowledge, while application-driven benchmarks only cover narrow, fragmented domains shaped by heuristic designs. To address these limitations, PerceptionBench adopts a bottom-up approach: by diagnosing the earliest failure points in the responses of frontier MLLMs across 42 existing benchmarks, we construct an error taxonomy whose perception branch defines ten atomic perceptual capabilities. Guided by this taxonomy, we construct 3,000 verified questions with short, unambiguous answers, each isolating a single capability, with difficulty stemming from perception rather than reasoning or knowledge. Benchmark results across sixteen frontier MLLMs reveal that atomic perception remains largely unsolved---no model reaches 60\% accuracy, perception-related hallucination is the weakest capability on average, and similar overall scores conceal sharply divergent capability profiles. PerceptionBench thus provides a capability-level standard for measuring and diagnosing the visual perception boundaries of MLLMs.
2607.24957.abstract_zh: 本文提出PerceptionBench，一个专门用于评估多模态大语言模型（Multimodal Large Language Models，MLLMs）原子视觉感知能力的基准测试。现有基准往往难以有效分离感知能力：整体性评估常将感知错误与推理或领域知识缺陷相混淆，而应用导向的基准仅覆盖由启发式设计形成的狭窄、碎片化领域。为突破这些局限，PerceptionBench采用自底向上的构建方法：通过系统诊断前沿MLLMs在42个现有基准测试中响应过程的最早失效点，我们构建了一个错误分类体系，其感知分支定义了十项原子感知能力。在此分类体系指导下，我们构建了3,000道经过验证的、具有简短明确答案的测试题目，每道题隔离单一能力维度，其难度源于感知本身而非推理或知识缺陷。对十六个前沿MLLMs的基准测试结果表明，原子感知能力总体上仍未得到解决——没有任何模型达到60%的准确率，感知相关幻觉（perception-related hallucination）平均表现最弱，且相似的总分背后隐藏着截然不同的能力分布特征。因此，PerceptionBench为衡量和诊断MLLMs的视觉感知边界提供了能力层级的标准化工具。

2607.23514.title: Novel Claim or Déjà Vu? Rethinking "Contamination-Free'' Dynamic Evaluation for Multimodal Automated Fact-Checking
2607.23514.abstract: Multimodal automated fact-checking (MAFC) verifies claims by retrieving and reasoning over external evidence. However, most existing static benchmarks risk contamination: they primarily consist of outdated claims verifiable using an LLM's internal knowledge without external evidence. This can inflate performance estimates and fail to reflect true capability on novel claims that require up-to-date information. To address this, emerging dynamic benchmarks collect claims published after LLMs' knowledge cut-off dates, assuming they are uncontaminated. This work revisits this assumption by empirically studying contamination risks in both the state-of-the-art (SOTA) static AVeriTeC benchmark and our newly constructed dynamic ClaimReview2025Q4 benchmark, as well as their impact on MAFC evaluation. Our experiments yield 16 findings, highlighting three key results: (1) Dynamic evaluation reduces but does not eliminate contamination risks, as 17.09\%--29.30\% of post-cut-off claims remain potentially contaminated; (2) Many newly published claims can be verified either directly or by synthesizing multiple pieces of public knowledge available before the cut-off; and (3) Contamination can induce statistically significant inflation in MAFC performance, increasing Macro-F1 by up to 11.34 points and distorting system rankings. In light of these findings, we re-evaluate SOTA LLMs under a strictly contamination-controlled setting. Our study provides practical guidelines for trustworthy MAFC evaluation.
2607.23514.abstract_zh: 多模态自动事实核查（MAFC）通过检索并基于外部证据进行推理来验证主张。然而，现有静态基准大多存在污染风险：它们主要由过时的主张构成，这些主张可通过大型语言模型（LLM）的内部知识而不依赖外部证据进行验证。这可能导致性能评估虚高，且无法反映模型在需要最新信息的新颖主张上的真实能力。为解决此问题，新兴的动态基准收集在LLM知识截止日期后发布的主张，假定其未被污染。本研究通过实证分析，重新审视这一假设，考察了当前最先进的静态基准AVeriTeC与我们新构建的动态基准ClaimReview2025Q4中的污染风险，及其对MAFC评估的影响。实验得出16项发现，突出以下三个关键结果：（1）动态评估虽能降低但无法完全消除污染风险，截至日期后仍有17.09%—29.30%的主张可能受到污染；（2）许多新发布的主张可通过截止日期前已公开的单个或多个知识片段直接或组合验证；（3）污染可导致MAFC性能出现统计学意义上的显著虚高，使Macro-F1最高提升11.34个百分点，并扭曲系统排名。基于这些发现，我们在严格控制的污染环境下重新评估了最先进的LLMs。本研究为可信赖的MAFC评估提供了实践指导。

2607.26004.title: Parallel Decoding Distillation for Fast Image and Video Generation
2607.26004.abstract: Generation in video diffusion or flow models is computationally expensive due to the slow and iterative sampling process. Current state-of-the-art (SOTA) acceleration methods heavily rely on variational score distillation (VSD) and adversarial losses to distill diffusion models into few-step generators. Albeit achieving high-quality video generation, these training losses are notoriously hard to optimize and suffer from mode collapse, leading to loss of video diversity and lack of motion. In this paper, we introduce Parallel Decoding Distillation (PDD), a simplified and scalable trajectory-based distillation method for fast inference of diffusion and flow matching models. Our architecture and training procedure are compatible with any pre-trained model and support sampling with a varying number of function evaluations (NFE). PDD accelerates generation by predicting multiple denoising steps per network evaluation. Conceptually, it learns a representation of the mean velocity without regressing its derivative using JVPs or finite-difference approximations. Our method achieves SOTA performance with 4-8 NFE on LTX-2.3 Text-to-Video/Audio, Wan 14B Text-to-Video, and Qwen-Image Text-to-Image. Moreover, PDD presents a significant improvement in generated video diversity.
2607.26004.abstract_zh: 视频扩散或流模型中的生成过程因采样缓慢且迭代而在计算上代价高昂。当前最先进的加速方法严重依赖于变分分数蒸馏与对抗损失，以将扩散模型提炼为少步生成器。尽管实现了高质量视频生成，但这些训练损失函数因其难以优化且易遭遇模式坍缩而闻名，导致视频多样性丧失与运动表现不足。本文提出并行解码蒸馏方法——一种简化且可扩展的基于轨迹的蒸馏方法，用于实现扩散模型与流匹配模型的快速推理。我们的架构与训练流程兼容任何预训练模型，并支持通过可变函数评估次数进行采样。该方法通过单次网络评估预测多个去噪步骤来加速生成过程。其核心思想在于学习平均速度的表征，而无需使用雅可比向量积或有限差分近似来回归其导数。我们的方法在LTX-2.3文本到视频/音频、Wan 14B文本到视频及Qwen-Image文本到图像任务上，以4-8次函数评估实现了最先进的性能表现。此外，并行解码蒸馏在生成视频多样性方面展现出显著提升。

2607.25948.title: MODUS: Decoder-Only Any-to-Any Modeling of Diverse Modalities
2607.25948.abstract: Any-to-any models predict any modality from any combination of others within a single network, a formulation used in multimodal vision and vision-language models, and increasingly in scientific domains such as ecology and astronomy. Existing any-to-any models are typically trained from scratch using encoder-decoder or diffusion architectures, impacting their performance and preventing them from using strong pre-trained decoder-only models as a prior. In this work, we investigate decoder-only any-to-any multimodal modeling, which treats all modalities symmetrically and supports arbitrary modalities as inputs and outputs without modality-specific heads, losses, or task pipelines. Because every modality is both an input and an output of the same model, the resulting model, named Modus, can support a range of applications, such as chained generation through intermediate modalities or cross-modal self-verification by scoring the model's own outputs with another generated modality. Modus demonstrates strong out-of-the-box performance and is competitive with specialist and multitask baselines using a single model across various benchmarks. All materials are open-sourced atthis https URL.
2607.25948.abstract_zh: 任意到任意模型可在单一网络内根据任意模态组合预测任意模态，这一框架已应用于多模态视觉和视觉语言模型，并日益拓展至生态学、天文学等科学领域。现有的任意到任意模型通常基于编码器-解码器或扩散架构从头训练，这限制了其性能表现，且无法利用强大的仅解码预训练模型作为先验。本研究探索了仅解码的任意到任意多模态建模方法，该方法对所有模态进行对称处理，支持任意模态作为输入和输出，无需依赖特定模态的头部模块、损失函数或任务流水线。由于每种模态既是同一模型的输入也是输出，我们将其命名为Modus的模型能够支持多种应用场景，例如通过中间模态进行链式生成，或借助其他生成模态对模型自身输出进行跨模态自我验证评分。Modus在多种基准测试中展现出优异的开箱即用性能，其单一模型的表现可与专业模型及多任务基线模型相竞争。所有材料均已通过此https链接开源。

2607.25537.title: Visual prompt engineering for video models
2607.25537.abstract: In the age of foundation models, a model is only as good as its prompt. For this reason, prompt engineering has become an essential technique for improving language model performance. Since video models are currently becoming foundation models for visual tasks (e.g., visual reasoning), we here ask whether they similarly benefit from visual prompt engineering: automatically modifying the task image to improve model performance. For example, for a visual physics reasoning task ("Where does the ball land, after passing a set of obstacles?"), an abstract sketch-like scene can be turned into a photorealistic version with a simple call to an image editing model. We find that visual prompt engineering, or VIPE for short, improves video reasoning performance across tasks. In fact, for video models, visual prompt engineering can be even more effective than classic text-based prompt engineering or test-time scaling. Ultimately, just as text-based prompt engineering systematically improves language model performance, visual prompt engineering can serve as a simple, compute-efficient approach to elicit better visual reasoning performance from video models. Example videos on our project page atthis https URL.
2607.25537.abstract_zh: 在基础模型时代，模型的性能很大程度上取决于提示的质量。因此，提示工程已成为提升语言模型性能的关键技术。鉴于当前视频模型正逐渐成为视觉任务（例如视觉推理）的基础模型，我们在此探讨其是否同样能从视觉提示工程中获益：即通过自动修改任务图像来提升模型性能。例如，对于视觉物理推理任务（“球在穿过一系列障碍物后会落在何处？”），只需调用图像编辑模型，就能将抽象的草图式场景转化为逼真的照片级版本。我们发现，视觉提示工程（简称VIPE）能够普遍提升视频推理任务的表现。事实上，对于视频模型而言，视觉提示工程甚至可能比传统的基于文本的提示工程或测试时缩放更为有效。最终，正如基于文本的提示工程能系统性地提升语言模型性能，视觉提示工程也可作为一种简单、计算高效的方法，从视频模型中激发出更优的视觉推理能力。示例视频请参见我们的项目页面（此https网址）。

2607.25669.title: OmniDelta: Skill-Driven Budget Allocation for Token Compression in OmniLLMs
2607.25669.abstract: Emerging Omni-modal Large Language Models (OmniLLMs) enable unified understanding of text, audio, and video, but their long audio-video token sequences introduce substantial memory and inference costs. Existing compression methods mainly focus on selecting important tokens under fixed budgets, leaving the preceding budget-allocation problem underexplored. We show that direct query-to-audio/video similarity is unreliable for inter-modal budget allocation, and that uniform intra-modal budgets can miss key evidence while retaining redundant content. To address these limitations, we propose OmniDelta, a training-free, skill-driven framework that couples intent-aware inter-modal allocation with content-aware intra-modal allocation. OmniDelta first constructs audio and video skill pools to shift the fixed retained-token budget according to query demand, then reallocates modality budgets over audio segments and video frames using local complexity and temporal redundancy. The resulting local budgets can be combined with existing pruning strategies, preserving the total retained-token ratio while changing where the budget is spent. Experiments on four audio-video benchmarks with two Qwen2.5-Omni models show that OmniDelta establishes a new accuracy-efficiency Pareto frontier across pruning ratios. At 25% token retention on Qwen2.5-Omni-7B, OmniDelta reduces GPU memory by 22.0% and achieves a 1.64x end-to-end speedup over full-token inference.
2607.25669.abstract_zh: 新兴的全模态大语言模型（Omni-modal Large Language Models，OmniLLMs）实现了对文本、音频和视频的统一理解，但其冗长的音视频标记序列带来了显著的内存与推理开销。现有压缩方法主要聚焦于在固定预算下选择重要标记，而前置的预算分配问题尚未得到充分探索。我们发现，直接基于查询与音频/视频的相似性进行跨模态预算分配并不可靠，且统一的模态内预算分配可能遗漏关键证据同时保留冗余内容。为应对这些局限，本文提出OmniDelta——一种无需训练、基于技能驱动的框架，该框架将意图感知的跨模态分配与内容感知的模态内分配相结合。OmniDelta首先构建音频与视频技能池，根据查询需求动态调整固定的保留标记预算，进而利用局部复杂度与时间冗余性，在音频片段和视频帧间重新分配模态预算。所得的局部预算可与现有剪枝策略结合，在保持总保留标记比例不变的同时改变预算的分配位置。在四个音视频基准测试中使用两种Qwen2.5-Omni模型进行的实验表明，OmniDelta在不同剪枝比例下构建了新的精度-效率帕累托前沿。在Qwen2.5-Omni-7B模型上保持25%标记保留率时，OmniDelta将GPU内存降低22.0%，并实现相较于全标记推理1.64倍的端到端加速。

2607.25091.title: Towards Robust Reinforcement Learning for Small-Scale Language Model Agents
2607.25091.abstract: The alignment of Small Language Models (SLMs) in the 70--500M parameter range using reinforcement learning is often considered unstable, though the underlying failure mechanisms have not been systematically investigated. In the State-of-the-Art (SOTA) research, fifteen (model, corpus) configurations were trained using Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO). The experiments included Pythia-70M, 160M, 410M and SmolLM2-135M, 360M on the TinyStories, CNN/DailyMail, and Wikitext-103 corpora. Three reproducible failure modes were identified in small-scale language models: silent LoRA parameter freezing in standard PEFT/TRL pipelines, numerical overflow in importance ratios when using bfloat16, and catastrophic policy collapse due to reward-model error. These issues were addressed using a merge-and-reinitialize adapter technique, float32 precision during PPO updates, and a three-layer safety mechanism comprising reward whitening, importance-ratio guarding, and weight rollback. In this paper, a capacity-headroom hypothesis is proposed, which states that PPO performance at the SLM scale depends on both a fluent supervised model ($\text{PPL}<20$) and a discriminative reward signal, rather than on the number of model parameters. The proposed system converged stably in all experiments and improved preference win rate over the SFT baseline in configurations with a fluent prior and an informative reward signal. Furthermore, it outperformed instruction-tuned baselines while requiring significantly less training data. All checkpoints, preference datasets, and training scripts are publicly released$^§$.
2607.25091.abstract_zh: 在70-500M参数规模的小型语言模型(Small Language Models, SLMs)中，使用强化学习进行对齐通常被认为是不稳定的，但其背后的失效机制尚未得到系统性研究。在现有最先进技术(State-of-the-Art, SOTA)研究中，我们使用近端策略优化(Proximal Policy Optimization, PPO)对十五种(模型，语料库)配置进行了训练。实验涵盖Pythia-70M、160M、410M以及SmolLM2-135M、360M模型，并在TinyStories、CNN/DailyMail和Wikitext-103语料库上进行。研究识别出小规模语言模型中三种可复现的失效模式：标准参数高效微调(Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning, PEFT)/TRL流程中出现的LoRA参数静默冻结、使用bfloat16时重要性比值的数值溢出，以及因奖励模型误差导致的灾难性策略崩溃。针对这些问题，我们采用合并重初始化适配器技术、PPO更新期间的float32精度，以及包含奖励白化、重要性比值防护和权重回滚的三层安全机制予以解决。本文提出容量余量假说，该假说认为在SLM规模下PPO的性能取决于流畅的监督模型(困惑度$\text{PPL}<20$)和具有判别力的奖励信号，而非模型参数量。提出的系统在所有实验中均稳定收敛，并在具备流畅先验模型和有效奖励信号的配置中，相较于监督微调(Supervised Fine-Tuning, SFT)基线提升了偏好胜率。此外，该系统在显著减少训练数据需求的同时，性能优于指令微调的基线模型。所有模型检查点、偏好数据集和训练脚本均已公开发布$^§$。

2607.25572.title: Mapping CVEs to MITRE ATT&CK Techniques: A Curated Gold-Set Classifier and the Limits of LLM-Assisted Label Expansion
2607.25572.abstract: We present a reproducible pipeline for mapping Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVEs) to MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise techniques from free-text vulnerability descriptions. Rather than relying on the CWE->CAPEC->ATT&CK derivation chain, whose table-expansion artifacts we quantify, we train a multi-label classifier on a curated gold dataset of 1,207 CVEs from expert MITRE Center for Threat-Informed Defense mappings. The resulting model approximately doubles recall@5 compared with a zero-shot embedding-similarity baseline and improves every ranking metric. We then investigate whether LLM-assisted labeling can extend the gold dataset. Initial experiments suggest contradictory conclusions: a single run indicates degraded performance, while averaging over five random seeds suggests a small gain. However, an independent replication and an expansion-size study (100--984 additional CVEs) show that the apparent improvement is an evaluation artifact. LLM-generated labels, with approximately 0.39 agreement with expert annotations, provide no reliable improvement at any expansion size and reduce rare-technique coverage at around 1,000 added CVEs (macro-F1 decreases by 0.04). The root cause is evaluation noise. Selecting checkpoints on a small test split effectively maximizes over many noisy evaluations, producing recall@5 differences of up to 0.05 between otherwise identical runs. Using a corrected protocol based on validation-split checkpoint selection, the gold-only model achieves recall@5 of (0.673 \pm 0.019), and repeating the decisive experiment confirms the null result for LLM expansion. A final scaling study shows that additional expert-curated data consistently improves performance, whereas LLM-labeled data does not, indicating that the classifier is limited by label quality rather than dataset size. All datasets, models, code, and training logs are publicly released.
2607.25572.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种可复现的管道，用于将通用漏洞披露（CVE）从自由文本漏洞描述映射至MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise技术框架。不同于依赖存在表格扩展伪影（我们已量化该问题）的CWE->CAPEC->ATT&CK衍生链，我们在一个由MITRE威胁情报防御中心专家标注的1,207个CVE精编黄金数据集上训练了一个多标签分类器。与零样本嵌入相似性基线相比，所得模型的召回率@5（recall@5）约提升一倍，且所有排序指标均有改善。随后我们探究了大型语言模型（LLM）辅助标注能否扩展黄金数据集。初步实验显示出矛盾的结论：单次运行表明性能下降，而五次随机种子的平均结果则暗示有微小增益。然而，独立复现实验及扩展规模研究（增加100至984个CVE）表明，这种表面改进实为评估伪影。LLM生成标签与专家标注的一致性约为0.39，在任何扩展规模下均未带来可靠改进，且在增加约1,000个CVE时降低了稀有技术覆盖度（宏F1值下降0.04）。其根本原因在于评估噪声：在小型测试集上选择检查点会有效放大诸多噪声评估，导致在相同运行条件下召回率@5差异最高达0.05。采用基于验证集检查点选择的修正方案后，纯黄金数据模型实现了(0.673 ± 0.019)的召回率@5，且重复决定性实验证实了LLM扩展的无效性。最终规模化研究表明，额外专家标注数据持续提升模型性能，而LLM标注数据则无此效果，这表明分类器的瓶颈在于标注质量而非数据集规模。所有数据集、模型、代码及训练日志均已公开发布。

2607.24176.title: Where Quality Breaks in Compressed Short-Text Generation: Staged Bottleneck Localization
2607.24176.abstract: Compressed short-text generators can fail in two different places: the codec may discard information before generation starts, or the latent generator may produce weak codes. Without separating these failure modes, researchers can spend compute improving the wrong component. We study this problem in a controlled 64-to-16 TinyStories case study built from a hierarchical VQ-VAE-2 codec and a masked discrete diffusion generator (MDLM). We use a staged validation protocol that separates codec reconstruction fidelity, latent generation quality, and auxiliary latent diagnostics under one shared external GPT-2 scorer, while reporting complementary semantic metrics for the geometry study. In the tested configuration, codec reconstruction alone raises median external perplexity from 15.17 to 27.36 (+80.4%) and p95 from 25.10 to 98.91 (+294.1%), showing that the dominant quality loss appears before latent generation begins. Under the same scorer, code-space MDLM remains materially stronger than token-space diffusion, reducing mean, median, and p95 by 32.9%, 30.9%, and 36.6%, respectively. Geometry-aware regularization improves local latent proxies but does not improve decoded-text metrics in the available runs. The contribution is methodological rather than algorithmic: the paper presents a reusable staged diagnosis for one concrete pipeline and shows that, in this setting, codec fidelity rather than latent denoising sets the practical quality ceiling.
2607.24176.abstract_zh: 压缩短文本生成器可能在两个不同环节失效：编解码器可能在生成开始前丢弃信息，或者潜在生成器可能产生低质量编码。若不区分这些失效模式，研究者可能会消耗算力改进错误的组件。我们通过一个受控的64到16词元TinyStories案例研究该问题，该案例基于分层VQ-VAE-2编解码器和掩码离散扩散生成器（MDLM）构建。我们采用分阶段验证方案，在共享的外部GPT-2评分器框架下，分别评估编解码器重建保真度、潜在生成质量及辅助潜在诊断指标，同时为几何结构研究提供补充性语义度量。在测试配置中，仅编解码器重建就使外部困惑度中位数从15.17上升至27.36（+80.4%），p95分位数从25.10上升至98.91（+294.1%），这表明主要质量损失出现在潜在生成开始之前。在同一评分器下，代码空间MDLM仍显著优于词元空间扩散模型，将均值、中位数和p95分位数分别降低32.9%、30.9%和36.6%。几何感知正则化在现有实验运行中改善了局部潜在代理指标，但未能提升解码文本的度量结果。本研究的贡献在于方法论而非算法创新：本文针对具体流程提出可复用的分阶段诊断方案，并证明在当前设定下，决定实际质量上限的是编解码器保真度而非潜在去噪能力。

2607.25236.title: VisualPatchWorld: Code World Models as Latent Structured Representations for Planning
2607.25236.abstract: Different research lines use the term world model in different ways, yet they share a common aim: to capture how the world evolves under action in a form that supports perception, simulation, and planning. Two prominent realizations are neural predictors that learn dynamics in continuous vector spaces, and hand-built physics engines that expose explicit state and physical laws. Neural predictors scale from data but leave the form of the dynamics implicit; physics engines are inspectable and editable but difficult to construct at scale. We introduce VisualPatchWorld (VPW), which represents world dynamics as code. VPW first selects a qualitative dynamical form with short active probes, then fits that form's free parameters from recorded state-action traces by minimizing multi-step prediction error. The resulting programs can be rolled forward like a simulator, inspected in source form, and used inside model-predictive control; image-derived scene graphs can supply the live state at replan time. Across comparisons with prior code-based world models, VPW attains 69.0% mean planning success and exceeds the strongest code baseline by 23.5 points. The largest gains arise when choosing the correct qualitative dynamics is essential. Under the same planner, the induced models approach ground-truth engine success on navigation and grasp-rich control; a residual gap remains for contact-rich pushing, and checking a shortlist of promising plans in the engine closes most of that gap. These results establish a practical route toward automatically constructed code world models that are useful for planning. Code is available atthis https URL.
2607.25236.abstract_zh: 不同研究方向对世界模型（world model）这一术语的使用方式各异，但它们的核心目标一致：以支持感知、仿真与规划的形式，捕捉世界在行动影响下的演化规律。两种主流实现方式分别是学习连续向量空间动力学的神经预测器，以及基于显式状态与物理定律构建的手工物理引擎。神经预测器能够从数据中实现规模化学习，但使动力学形式隐式化；物理引擎虽可检视与编辑，却难以大规模构建。本文提出视觉补丁世界模型（VisualPatchWorld，VPW），其将世界动力学以代码形式呈现。VPW首先通过短时主动探测选定定性动力学形式，随后通过最小化多步预测误差，根据记录的状态-行动轨迹拟合该形式的自由参数。所得程序可像仿真器一样向前推演，以源代码形式检视，并用于模型预测控制；从图像衍生的场景图可在重规划时提供实时状态。在与以往基于代码的世界模型比较中，VPW实现了69.0%的平均规划成功率，较最优代码基线提升23.5个百分点。当正确选择定性动力学形式至关重要时，VPW取得的提升最为显著。在相同规划器下，所构建模型在导航与抓取密集型控制任务中接近真实物理引擎的成功率；对于接触密集型推动任务仍存在残余差距，通过在引擎中检验有潜力的候选规划方案可弥补大部分差距。这些结果为构建可用于规划的自动化代码世界模型开辟了实用路径。代码可通过此链接获取：https://URL。

2607.25337.title: Temporal-Distance JEPA: Plan-Aware Representation Learning for Latent World Model Predictive Control
2607.25337.abstract: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) learn world models by predicting in representation space rather than reconstructing pixels, making them a natural backbone for latent model predictive control from offline demonstration logs. JEPA-style training optimizes short-horizon latent prediction, whereas planning requires a multi-step ranking of imagined futures by goal progress. Prior JEPA planners often inherit that ranking from embedding geometry, typically latent Euclidean distance, which arises as a byproduct of representation learning rather than as a progress cost mined from the logs. We propose temporal-distance JEPA (TD-JEPA), which retains the LeWM encoder--predictor backbone and mines a directed temporal cost from reward-free trajectories: same-trajectory step order supplies positive targets, cross-trajectory pairs act as heuristic negatives, and a rollout-consistency term matches the planner horizon. The mined supervision serves two roles: as the deployed planning cost when progress is topological, and as a representation signal that improves Euclidean planning when contact geometry dominates. Under locked evaluation, deploying the mined cost raises Two-Room success to 100.0% versus LeWM's 97.4%, while shared Euclidean planning on the same temporally trained checkpoint raises OGB-Cube by 14.2 points over LeWM and improves Push-T. Against LeWM and the concurrent RC-aux baseline under locked evaluation, TD-JEPA matches or exceeds both methods on every environment. Ablations show that the directed head, cross-trajectory negatives, and rollout consistency each contribute. TD-JEPA narrows the train--plan gap for JEPA world-model planners by discovering temporal progress structure in offline logs and co-designing cost form with plan-time deployment. Code is available atthis https URL.
2607.25337.abstract_zh: 联合嵌入预测架构（Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures, JEPAs）通过在表示空间中进行预测而非重构像素来学习世界模型，这使其成为基于离线演示日志的潜在模型预测控制的天然骨干。JEPA式训练优化短时程潜在预测，而规划则需要对想象中未来状态按目标进展进行多步骤排序。以往的JEPA规划器通常从嵌入几何（尤其是潜在欧氏距离）中继承这种排序机制，这往往作为表示学习的副产品出现，而非从日志中挖掘出的进展成本。我们提出了时序距离JEPA（Temporal-Distance JEPA, TD-JEPA），该方法保留了LeWM编码器-预测器骨干结构，并从无奖励轨迹中挖掘出一种有向时序成本：同一轨迹的步序提供正样本目标，跨轨迹配对作为启发式负样本，而展开一致性项则与规划时域相匹配。挖掘出的监督信号具有双重作用：在进展具有拓扑特性时作为部署规划成本；在接触几何占主导时作为表示信号以改进欧氏距离规划。在固定评估设置下，采用挖掘出的成本使Two-Room环境成功率提升至100.0%（LeWM为97.4%），而在相同时序训练检查点上采用共享欧氏规划时，OGB-Cube任务得分较LeWM提高14.2分并改善了Push-T任务表现。在与LeWM及同期RC-aux基线方法的固定评估对比中，TD-JEPA在各项环境中均达到或超越两者的性能。消融实验表明，有向预测头、跨轨迹负样本和展开一致性项均对性能提升有所贡献。TD-JEPA通过发现离线日志中的时序进展结构，并将成本形式与规划时部署协同设计，从而缩小了JEPA世界模型规划器的训练-规划差距。代码发布于此https网址。

2607.22135.title: GLI-AL: A Multi-Modal Glioma MRI Label Resource with Unified Anatomy-Lesion Labels
2607.22135.abstract: Existing BraTS-GLI datasets provide a widely used benchmark for adult glioma MRI segmentation, but their task definition focuses on tumor subregions and does not systematically represent coexisting white matter hyperintensities (WMH). In joint segmentation settings, such unlabeled abnormalities introduce task-specific label noise by treating pathological regions as normal tissue. To address this limitation, we introduce BraTS-GLI Anatomy-Lesion, a controlled-access, labels-only derived resource built from the BraTS 2023-GLI training cohort. The resource provides 1,251 unified eight-class anatomy-lesion label sets aligned with the original four-modal MRI cases, including image-repair labels for 116 cases requiring repaired imaging inputs. The cohort is organized into a 394-case purified subset and an 857-case extended subset, with case-level metadata covering label source, image-repair requirements, quality-control status, access conditions, checksums, and release boundaries. Compared with the original BraTS-GLI annotations, the resource substantially expands foreground supervision by incorporating healthy brain tissues and previously unlabeled coexisting abnormalities within a unified label space. A validation study using MedNeXt and T1/FLAIR inputs suggests that WMH-aware supervision preserves healthy-tissue segmentation performance across both in-domain GLI and external WMH datasets, while improving sensitivity to coexisting lesions relative to noisy-control training. The resource is intended for scientific research and supports joint anatomy-lesion supervision, label-noise analysis, and reproducible evaluation. Data are available atthis https URL, and code is available atthis https URL. The data resource DOI isthis https URL.
2607.22135.abstract_zh: 现有的BraTS-GLI数据集为成人胶质瘤（glioma）MRI分割提供了广泛使用的基准，但其任务定义聚焦于肿瘤亚区域，并未系统性地呈现共存的白质高信号（white matter hyperintensities, WMH）病变。在联合分割场景中，此类未标注的异常区域因被视作正常组织而引入了任务特定的标签噪声。为应对这一局限性，我们推出BraTS-GLI Anatomy-Lesion——一个基于BraTS 2023-GLI训练队列构建的受控访问、仅含标签的衍生资源。该资源提供了与原始四模态MRI病例对齐的1,251套统一八分类解剖-病变标签集，其中包含116例需要修复影像输入的病例所对应的图像修复标签。该队列被组织为包含394例病例的净化子集和857例病例的扩展子集，并配备覆盖标签来源、图像修复需求、质量控制状态、访问条件、校验和及发布范围的病例级元数据。与原始BraTS-GLI标注相比，该资源通过在统一标签空间中纳入健康脑组织及先前未标注的共存异常区域，显著扩展了前景监督范围。基于MedNeXt模型和T1/FLAIR影像输入的验证研究表明，具有WMH感知能力的监督方法在领域内GLI数据集和外部WMH数据集中均能保持健康组织分割性能，同时相对于含噪声的对照训练，对共存病变的检测敏感性有所提升。本资源面向科学研究，支持联合解剖-病变监督、标签噪声分析和可复现评估。数据可通过此链接获取：https://example.com，代码可通过此链接获取：https://example.com。本数据资源的数字对象标识符（DOI）为：https://example.com/doi。

2607.22117.title: Projection Pursuit CPCANet for Domain Generalization
2607.22117.abstract: Domain Generalization (DG) aims to learn representations robust to distribution shifts. Recent geometric alignment methods, such as CPCANet, extract domain-invariant structures through batch-wise Common Principal Component Analysis (CPCA). However, CPCANet suffers from rank-deficient covariance estimation due to the small-sample-size issue in mini-batch training. To address this limitation, we propose Projection Pursuit CPCANet (PP-CPCANet), a covariance-free framework that learns a global orthogonal basis on the Stiefel manifold and jointly optimizes it with network parameters via the Cayley transform. We further introduce a symmetry-breaking detached-median PP dispersion objective to extract common principal components (CPCs) with dense and robust optimization signals. Experiments on four DG benchmarks show that PP-CPCANet achieves SOTA performance while maintaining stable training.
2607.22117.abstract_zh: 领域泛化（Domain Generalization，DG）旨在学习对分布变化具有鲁棒性的表征。近期基于几何对齐的方法，例如CPCANet，通过批式共同主成分分析（Common Principal Component Analysis，CPCA）提取域不变结构。然而，由于小批量训练中的小样本量问题，CPCANet存在协方差估计秩不足的缺陷。为解决这一局限，我们提出了投影追踪CPCANet（Projection Pursuit CPCANet，PP-CPCANet），这是一种无需显式协方差计算的框架，其在施蒂费尔流形（Stiefel manifold）上学习全局正交基，并通过凯莱变换（Cayley transform）将其与网络参数联合优化。我们进一步引入了一种对称性破缺的分离中位数投影追踪离散度目标函数，以提取具有密集且鲁棒优化信号的共同主成分（common principal components，CPCs）。在四个领域泛化基准测试上的实验表明，PP-CPCANet在保持训练稳定性的同时，实现了最先进的性能。

2607.12544.title: Edge-Aware Thermal Infrared UAV Swarm Tracking
2607.12544.abstract: Thermal infrared (TIR) imaging is essential for UAV swarm operations in visually degraded environments. However, tracking tiny UAVs remains challenging due to limited appearance cues, frequent occlusions, and rapid maneuvers. Despite significant progress driven by benchmarks such as the Anti-UAV challenge, existing methods primarily prioritize accuracy while overlooking the computational constraints of real-time edge deployment. The standard Kalman Filter (KF) offers the efficiency required for edge devices, yet its constant-velocity assumption often breaks down under highly dynamic UAV motion and thermal sensor jitter. More sophisticated nonlinear estimators can improve robustness but often introduce additional computational costs. To address this gap, we propose an edge-aware online tracking pipeline centered on the Adaptive Kinematic Kalman Filter (AKKF), which augments the linear KF with state-dependent kinematic modeling while preserving real-time efficiency. Combined with transient false-positive suppression and kinematics-driven predictive coasting, the presented pipeline improves trajectory continuity under challenging TIR conditions. Experiments on the Beyond Strong Baseline (BSB) benchmark provide a starting point for edge-aware UAV tracking by jointly evaluating tracking performance and computational efficiency, offering insights toward future real-time deployment.
2607.12544.abstract_zh: 热红外（Thermal Infrared, TIR）成像对于无人机（UAV）集群在视觉退化环境中的操作至关重要。然而，由于有限的外观光线索、频繁的遮挡以及快速的机动动作，跟踪微型无人机仍面临挑战。尽管在诸如反无人机挑战赛（Anti-UAV challenge）等基准测试的推动下取得了显著进展，现有方法主要侧重于精度，而忽略了实时边缘部署的计算限制。标准卡尔曼滤波器（Kalman Filter, KF）具备边缘设备所需的高效性，但其恒定速度假设在高度动态的无人机运动和热传感器抖动下常常失效。更复杂的非线性估计器可以提升鲁棒性，但往往带来额外的计算开销。为填补这一空白，我们提出了一种以自适应运动学卡尔曼滤波器（Adaptive Kinematic Kalman Filter, AKKF）为核心的边缘感知在线跟踪流程。该方法通过状态依赖的运动学建模增强了线性卡尔曼滤波器，同时保持了实时效率。结合瞬态误报抑制与运动学驱动的预测性持续跟踪，所提出的流程在具有挑战性的热红外条件下提升了轨迹连续性。在超越强基线（Beyond Strong Baseline, BSB）基准测试上的实验，通过联合评估跟踪性能与计算效率，为边缘感知的无人机跟踪提供了起点，并为未来的实时部署提供了启示。

2607.24223.short_zh: 用相关性引导代理搜索中的语料交互

2607.25565.short_zh: 从图像恢复可编辑设计文件

2607.24368.short_zh: 评估智能体记忆的隐性关联盲点

2607.24904.short_zh: 高效多模态流式基础模型
2607.24904.tags: 计算机视觉;多模态学习;视频理解与交互

2607.26057.short_zh: 接力轨迹优化缓解蒸馏偏差

2607.26004.short_zh: 并行解码蒸馏加速图像视频生成
2607.26004.tags: 生成模型；扩散模型；视频生成加速
2607.26004.body_summary:
当前视频生成模型因迭代采样慢而计算昂贵，现有加速方法优化难且易导致多样性下降。
本文提出并行解码蒸馏方法，通过单次预测多步去噪实现快速生成，在多个基准上取得高性能并提升了生成多样性。

2607.25948.short_zh: 构建通用多模态解码器
2607.25948.tags: 多模态学习;跨模态生成;任意到任意建模
2607.25948.body_summary:
现有多模态模型难以利用强大的预训练解码器进行对称的任意模态间生成。
提出了名为Modus的解码器专用模型，能对称处理任意模态的输入与输出，并在多种基准测试中展现强大性能。

2607.25537.short_zh: 视觉提示工程提升视频模型推理
2607.25537.tags: 计算机视觉；视频理解；视觉提示工程
2607.25537.body_summary:
基础模型时代，视频模型成为视觉任务基石，其表现与提示质量密切相关。
研究发现，通过自动修改任务图像进行视觉提示工程，能有效提升视频推理性能，优于文本提示或扩展计算。

2607.25669.short_zh: 针对多模态大模型的令牌压缩预算分配方法
2607.25669.tags: 多模态大语言模型；模型推理效率；多模态令牌压缩
2607.25669.body_summary:
新兴的全模态大语言模型能统一理解文本、音频和视频，但长音视频令牌序列带来了高内存和推理成本。
提出OmniDelta框架，通过意图感知的模态间预算分配和内容感知的模态内预算分配来动态优化令牌保留位置，提升模型效率。

2607.25091.short_zh: 提升小模型强化学习稳定性
2607.25091.tags: 自然语言处理;语言模型对齐;强化学习稳定性
2607.25091.body_summary:
使用强化学习对齐参数规模在0.7-5亿的小语言模型常遇稳定性问题，其失效机制未明
通过实验识别三种失败模式并针对性提出解决方案，验证了基于模型流利度与奖励信号的新假设，有效提升了小模型对齐的稳定性和效果

2607.25572.short_zh: 从漏洞描述映射攻击技术
2607.25572.tags: 网络安全;漏洞分析;漏洞攻击技术映射
2607.25572.body_summary:
研究如何从CVE漏洞描述自动映射到MITRE ATT&CK攻击技术，以提升映射的准确性和召回率。
训练了一个基于专家标注数据的多标签分类器，性能优于基线方法；并探究了利用大语言模型扩展标注数据的效果，发现其无法可靠提升模型性能且会降低稀有技术的覆盖度。

2607.24176.short_zh: 压缩短文本生成质量瓶颈定位
2607.24176.tags: 自然语言处理;文本生成;压缩短文本生成
2607.24176.body_summary:
研究压缩短文本生成中质量损失的根源，区分是压缩编码器信息丢失还是潜在生成器性能不佳。
通过分阶段验证方法，在一个具体实验中发现编码器信息丢失是主要瓶颈，并展示了该方法可复用于定位生成链路的性能问题。

2607.25236.short_zh: 用代码构建世界模型辅助规划
2607.25236.tags: 机器人学;机器人规划;代码化世界模型
2607.25236.body_summary:
世界模型旨在用可支持感知、仿真与规划的形式捕捉环境在动作作用下的演化规律，现有神经预测器和手工物理引擎各有优劣。
本文提出VisualPatchWorld方法，通过主动探测选择定性动力学形式，再用状态-动作轨迹拟合参数，生成可仿真、可检查的代码模型，显著提升了规划成功率。

2607.25337.short_zh: 时距预测世界模型规划
2607.25337.tags: 机器学习;表示学习;世界模型预测控制
2607.25337.body_summary:
JEPA类预训练模型从离线日志中学习世界模型，但预测损失与规划所需的长期未来评估存在差距。
提出时距预测JEPA，通过挖掘轨迹中的时序距离作为规划成本和表示学习信号，提升离线世界模型的规划性能。

2607.22135.short_zh: 提供多模态胶质瘤MRI统一病灶标签资源
2607.22135.tags: 医学图像分析;医学图像分割;脑部病灶联合分割
2607.22135.body_summary:
现有胶质瘤分割数据集未系统标注脑白质高信号等共存病灶，带来标签噪声
构建了包含统一八类解剖-病灶标签的新标注集，验证了其对分割性能的提升

2607.22117.tags: 机器学习;领域泛化;协方差建模
2607.22117.body_summary:
领域泛化旨在学习对分布变化鲁棒的表征，但现有方法在小批量训练中存在协方差估计秩亏问题。
提出无需协方差的投影追踪网络，通过流形优化和分离中位数目标稳定提取公共主成分，在多个基准上达到先进性能。

2607.12544.short_zh: 红外无人机群实时跟踪
2607.12544.tags: 计算机视觉;目标跟踪;红外无人机跟踪
2607.12544.body_summary:
热红外成像在视觉退化环境下对无人机群跟踪至关重要，但现有方法难以兼顾实时边缘部署的计算限制。
提出一种以自适应运动学卡尔曼滤波为核心的边缘感知跟踪流程，提升动态场景下的轨迹连续性并保持实时性。
